cdif:takesValuesFrom.schema:name: Five-point agreement scale
cdif:takesValuesFrom.schema:description: The ordered categories strongly disagree, disagree, neither agree nor disagree, agree, strongly agree. No external codelist is cited, so the admitted values are stated here in prose.
cdif:takesValuesFrom.cdif:purpose: Record ordered attitudinal responses without committing the survey to an external code register.

cdi:isDescribedBy.cdi:description: Five ordered response categories. The order of the categories is meaningful but the intervals between them are not.
